notes.title: Playtest 0.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
This is a small update to fix and improve a few issues with the game:


 Behind the scenes rework to support future abilities
 Improved menu stack back navigation (now remembers state)
 Camera now centers on unit when levelling up
 Fixed bug where misses were granting EXP
 Improved balance/difficulty for first few main quests
 Improved visibility of disabled buttons
 Fix bug where you could Stiff Arm a unit into a tree or bridge
 Ensure Disenchant can't be cast on Walloped units
 ...and other misc. fixes!


Please check it out and let me know if you have any feedback using the in-app feedback form. Happy playing!

notes.title: (BIG) Playtest Update 0.3.0!
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for your continued support of Fantasy Football Tactics and the invaluable feedback you have provided me. I'm happy to report that 0.3.0 is live and has some big updates:


Controller Support (YAY!)
Remote Play Together
Camera Controls
Team and Field Selection in Quick Match mode
Improved UI/UX
Improved Wallops and Super Fumbles
Several bug fixes
...and more!

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.2.0!
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for checking out Fantasy Football Tactics and providing your feedback. 

New in this build:

 Settings! Control for audio, video and a11y (screen shake) are now live.
 UI Updates, including new fonts, panel backgrounds and (some) smaller buttons.
 KOs have been replaced by the WALLOPED! Status. Guaranteed hits and Super Fumbles until their next turn.
 Yes, and SUPER FUMBLES! Tackle a WALLOPED! opponent to make the ball fly towards your goal.
 And lots of other fixes/improvements. Let me know what you think!
